native: Existing FULLMIX_EVENT_SEQUENCE.json family F_MIX only; preserve every candidate, no regeneration. Out-of-domain candidates retained with flag and excluded only from acoustic-domain statistics.

grid.BPM: unchanged local_bpm of frozen reference quarter
grid.nearest: Decimal timestamp nearest stored quarter, exact tie earlier quarter; flag missing side, no extrapolation
grid.sign: negative before, zero exact at stored precision, positive after

frozen_logic.timing: Unchanged JGA-native timestamps. Quarter reference unresolved pending PI clarification. No timing-dependent source rules.
frozen_logic.drum_rule: ADTOF nearest DRUM within35ms OR MuScriptor U and C each nearest DRUM within35ms.
frozen_logic.bass_rule: MuScriptor UNCONSTRAINED nearest BASS within35ms AND at least one countable HIGH/MEDIUM frozen Bass inventory record whose preserved fmix_nearest_s equals this native timestamp. Conditioned Bass alone cannot establish support.
frozen_logic.states: Both booleans -> BASS_AND_DRUM_SUPPORTED; only drum -> DRUM_SUPPORTED; only bass -> BASS_SUPPORTED; neither -> UNKNOWN.
frozen_logic.conflict_handling: Bass+Drum or Piano coexistence is not a conflict. Model disagreement is retained in separate flags. No negative-source/exclusivity evidence is supplied by missing predictions; absent a demonstrated incompatible assignment, do not infer CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE.
frozen_logic.matching: Nearest across preserved common_115_130 outputs; ties earlier timestamp then event ID. Inclusive comparisons with 1e-9 ms floating-point tolerance.
frozen_logic.muscriptor_conditions: U=unconstrained; C=trio-conditioned. Both are same model, not independent confirmations. Concordance is exploratory supporting evidence, not separately validated specificity.
frozen_logic.bass_limitations: Frozen inventory association is historical model-assisted evidence, not independent source ground truth. Exact stored native link required; proximity alone not sufficient.
frozen_logic.new_independent_validation: None; qualified existing component validation, no claim of held-out combined-adapter validation.

adapter.extension: Context eligibility expanded only; logical rules,35ms tolerance and1e-9ms comparison epsilon unchanged. Preserve historical69 states and timings after compatibility check.
adapter.missing: Missing stream is unavailable, not negative evidence. Preserve any support established by complete rule clause; otherwise UNKNOWN with MISSING_EVIDENCE. Record stream failure separately. No manual identities.
adapter.conflict: No conflict from coexistence or missing prediction; preserve original conflict behavior.
adapter.abstention: Undefined metrics NA; failed inference not retried with altered settings; no alternate model or tuning.

context_rule: For each native timestamp choose first priority then start/name preserved context containing timestamp with50ms margins. common115130 always authoritative for original69. Otherwise use15s cores anchored0 with0.5s padding each side, clipped to acoustic domain; choose solely by candidate timestamp. Only infer cores owning uncovered candidates. No pooling/selection across alternate contexts. New hypotheses outside core retained as witnesses but queried only by owning candidates.
context_edges: Native events within50ms of acoustic boundary flagged; no extrapolated audio.
normalization: same benchmark raw start/end events; drums=DRUM, acoustic_bass/electric_bass/contrabass=BASS, acoustic_piano/electric_piano=PIANO, elseOTHER. ADTOF labelsallDRUM; no score quantization; external timing witness only.

windows.local_controls: preserve previously frozen W01/W02; reference overlap explicitly excluded from recurrence count
